nonceLedgerIsolated.note: TGT-10 is refused by STALE_REVISION, not by the ledger: a successful first use advances the hash-chained revision, so a replayed receipt is necessarily stale too. The ledger is therefore exercised here with the revision held constant — the only condition that distinguishes the two checks.
